messages:
incident-bot: automatic pager -> PagerDuty incident P24680 fired for pool: eu-central-gpu-2. Reason: repeated CUDA allocator failures (cudaErrorUnknown / OOM-like) on node eu-g2-11. Auto-evacuate triggered.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: https://pd.example.com/incidents/P24680 - priority: P2 - responders: eng-oncall

lee (oncall): acked. i'm connected to the cluster console. seeing lots of 'cublasCreate' and 'cudaMalloc' failures.

alex (eng-sre): is this across the pool or isolated to eu-g2-11?

lee (oncall): primary spike on eu-g2-11 (GPUs 0/1/2 are pegged at 100% mem), a few spillovers to eu-g2-12.

jamie (prod-support): support queue: 2 customers reported streaming interruptions, one enterprise account reported degraded latency ~20-30s. marking potential customer-impact.

lee (oncall): confirming customer-impact = yes. pinging CS to notify and log impacted customers.

ops-bot: Runbook hit: GPU-memory-pressure -> step 1: remove pool from rotation. Executing: `rictl pool disable eu-central-gpu-2 --reason "cuda alloc failures"`

ops-bot: command completed. New traffic will avoid eu-central-gpu-2.

patti (infra): provisioning hot-spare nodes in eu region now: `rictl pool scale --pool eu-central-gpu-2 --add 2 --flavor p4d` (ETA ~4m).

alex (eng-sre): logs show an immediate spike in long-context allocations after a canary deploy at 08:41. model tag: rwd-v3-longctx-unquant. can we throttle that model or route it to fallback?

lee (oncall): adding temporary route rule: `routectl set --service infer-api --match header:X-Model==rwd-v3-longctx-unquant --action deny` to stop new longctx allocations to this pool.

ops-bot: route rule applied.

lee (oncall): meanwhile i'll try soft-evict on eu-g2-11 to free KV cache first (non-disruptive). running:
```
rictl node exec --node eu-g2-11 -- "/opt/redwood/bin/soft-evict --target=gpu --age>60s --dry-run=false"
```

lee (oncall): soft-evict completed, freed approx 200MB per GPU, fragmentation still present though. memory pressure down to 70%.

alex (eng-sre): fragmentation + large contiguous allocs failing. if pressure doesn't drop to <60% in 5m we should hard-restart the infer-worker on that node. prep command:
```
drctl restart --service infer-worker --node eu-g2-11 --grace=10s
```

jamie (prod-support): enterprise accounts A-113 and B-77 notified via CS; A-113 wants ETA. I gave tentative 20-30m while we stabilize.

patti (infra): scale succeeded, new nodes coming up. also checking if GPU driver got upgraded in last deploy window; seeing a driver bump on eu-g2-11 at 08:40 — i will pin driver to previous build if needed.

lee (oncall): memory trending slowly down after evict + route. current pressure 58% on eu-g2-11. customers reporting reduced errors.

alex (eng-sre): good. follow-up actions: 1) refine alert to split fragmentation/cublas errors from generic OOM 2) add short-term rate-cap on models with >8k seq len 3) post-incident: auto-rollback of model pin when allocation spikes >X.

ops-bot: Incident P24680 acknowledged by lee (oncall). Escalation paused.

lee (oncall): i'm handing off in ~10m to patti. leaving notes in PD: actions taken, route rule id, evict logs, scale job id.

patti (infra): taking handoff. will validate driver pin and follow up with postmortem. proposing guardrail: block model tags without low-memory profile on high-density pools.

jamie (prod-support): customers A-113 and B-77 confirmed service restored. closing customer-impact alert on CS.

lee (oncall): closing active mitigation; status -> monitoring. adding follow-up ticket ENG-PI-1002 for alert-splitting + guardrails. thanks team. :tada:
